objectives.text: Review the bank's BSA/AML risk assessment process, and determine whether the bank has adequately identified the ML/TF and other illicit financial activity risks within its banking operations.

citations.quote: Objective: Review the bank's BSA/AML risk assessment process, and determine whether the bank has adequately identified the ML/TF and other illicit financial activity risks within its banking operations.

objectives.text: Provide standards for examiners to assess the adequacy of the bank's BSA/AML risk assessment process.

citations.quote: This section is designed to provide standards for examiners to assess the adequacy of the bank's BSA/AML risk assessment process.

obligations.action: develop an understanding of the bank's ML/TF and other illicit financial activity risks to evaluate the bank's BSA/AML compliance program
obligations.trigger: evaluating the bank's BSA/AML compliance program

citations.quote: Examiners must develop an understanding of the bank's ML/TF and other illicit financial activity risks to evaluate the bank's BSA/AML compliance program.

obligations.actor: The bank's BSA/AML risk assessment process
obligations.action: address the varying degrees of risk associated with its products, services, customers, and geographic locations, as appropriate

citations.quote: The bank's BSA/AML risk assessment process should address the varying degrees of risk associated with its products, services, customers, and geographic locations, as appropriate.

obligations.action: provide a comprehensive analysis of the bank's ML/TF and other illicit financial activity risks

citations.quote: The BSA/AML risk assessment should provide a comprehensive analysis of the bank's ML/TF and other illicit financial activity risks.

obligations.action: be provided to all business lines across the bank, the board of directors, management, and appropriate staff

citations.quote: The BSA/AML risk assessment should be provided to all business lines across the bank, the board of directors, management, and appropriate staff.

obligations.actor: A conclusion regarding the risk categories
obligations.action: be based on a consideration of all pertinent information

citations.quote: The identification of risk categories is bank-specific, and a conclusion regarding the risk categories should be based on a consideration of all pertinent information.

obligations.action: not criticize the bank for individual risk or process decisions unless those decisions impact the adequacy of some aspect of the bank's BSA/AML compliance program or the bank's compliance with BSA regulatory requirements
obligations.trigger: when the bank has established an appropriate BSA/AML risk assessment process, and has followed existing policies, procedures, and processes
exceptions: unless those decisions impact the adequacy of some aspect of the bank's BSA/AML compliance program or the bank's compliance with BSA regulatory requirements

citations.quote: When the bank has established an appropriate BSA/AML risk assessment process, and has followed existing policies, procedures, and processes, examiners should not criticize the bank for individual risk or process decisions unless those decisions impact the adequacy of some aspect of the bank's BSA/AML compliance program or the bank's compliance with BSA regulatory requirements.

obligations.action: focus on whether the bank has effective processes resulting in a well-developed BSA/AML risk assessment
obligations.trigger: when evaluating the BSA/AML risk assessment

citations.quote: When evaluating the BSA/AML risk assessment, examiners should focus on whether the bank has effective processes resulting in a well-developed BSA/AML risk assessment.

obligations.action: not take any single indicator as determinative of the existence of a lower- or higher-risk profile for the bank

citations.quote: Examiners should not take any single indicator as determinative of the existence of a lower- or higher-risk profile for the bank.

obligations.actor: A conclusion regarding the risk profile
obligations.action: be based on a consideration of all pertinent information

citations.quote: The assessment of risk factors is bank-specific, and a conclusion regarding the risk profile should be based on a consideration of all pertinent information.

obligations.action: assess whether the bank has developed a BSA/AML risk assessment that identifies its ML/TF and other illicit financial activity risks

citations.quote: Examiners should assess whether the bank has developed a BSA/AML risk assessment that identifies its ML/TF and other illicit financial activity risks.

obligations.action: assess whether the bank has considered all products, services, customers, and geographic locations, and whether the bank analyzed the information relative to those risk categories

citations.quote: Examiners should also assess whether the bank has considered all products, services, customers, and geographic locations, and whether the bank analyzed the information relative to those risk categories.

obligations.action: develop a BSA/AML risk assessment for the bank based on available information
obligations.trigger: whenever the bank has not developed a BSA/AML risk assessment, or the BSA/AML risk assessment is inadequate

citations.quote: For the purposes of the examination, whenever the bank has not developed a BSA/AML risk assessment, or the BSA/AML risk assessment is inadequate, examiners must develop a BSA/AML risk assessment for the bank based on available information.

obligations.action: develop appropriate policies, procedures, and processes to monitor and control its ML/TF and other illicit financial activity risks

citations.quote: Specifically, the bank should develop appropriate policies, procedures, and processes to monitor and control its ML/TF and other illicit financial activity risks.

obligations.actor: The bank's monitoring system to identify, research, and report suspicious activity
obligations.action: be risk-based to incorporate any necessary additional screening for higher-risk products, services, customers, and geographic locations as identified by the bank's BSA/AML risk assessment

citations.quote: the bank's monitoring system to identify, research, and report suspicious activity should be risk-based to incorporate any necessary additional screening for higher-risk products, services, customers, and geographic locations as identified by the bank's BSA/AML risk assessment

obligations.action: review the bank's BSA/AML risk assessment, including how it is used to develop the BSA/AML compliance program

citations.quote: Independent testing (audit) should review the bank's BSA/AML risk assessment, including how it is used to develop the BSA/AML compliance program.

obligations.actor: Banks that choose to implement a consolidated or partially consolidated BSA/AML compliance program
obligations.action: assess risk within business lines and across activities and legal entities
obligations.trigger: choosing to implement a consolidated or partially consolidated BSA/AML compliance program

citations.quote: Banks that choose to implement a consolidated or partially consolidated BSA/AML compliance program should assess risk within business lines and across activities and legal entities.

obligations.action: communicate across all business lines, activities, and legal entities to understand ML/TF and other illicit financial activity risk exposures
obligations.trigger: to understand ML/TF and other illicit financial activity risk exposures

citations.quote: To understand ML/TF and other illicit financial activity risk exposures, the banking organization should communicate across all business lines, activities, and legal entities.

notes: This is supervisory guidance (FFIEC examination manual), not a statute or regulation; the text expressly states the risk assessment is 'not a specific legal requirement' ('While not a specific legal requirement, a well-developed BSA/AML risk assessment assists the bank...') and that 'there is no requirement to update the BSA/AML risk assessment on a continuous or specified periodic basis' and 'There are no required risk categories.' Many duties are framed as 'should' (sound practice) rather than binding rules; extracted as written per fidelity rule. 'Must' obligations here run to examiners, not the bank. Documenting the risk assessment in writing is described as a 'sound practice,' not a mandate. The RA content itself sits in the program/pillars scope but this item is evidence/guidance only; SAR/CTR/CDD/CIP cross-references treated as coordination-layer pointers.
